name: Platō Coffee - Plettenberg Bay
address: 7 Crescent St, Plettenberg Bay, 6600, South Africa
description_short: Specialty coffee roastery and café serving expertly crafted brews with fresh pastries in Plett's town centre.
description_long:
Tucked on Crescent Street in the heart of Plettenberg Bay, Platō Coffee brings third-wave coffee culture to the Garden Route. This roastery and café takes its beans seriously, sourcing and roasting in small batches to deliver consistently excellent espresso-based drinks and filter coffees. The space strikes a balance between industrial minimalism and warmth, with plenty of natural light and counter seating where you can watch baristas at work.

The menu keeps things focused: think buttery croissants, seasonal tarts, and toasted sandwiches that pair perfectly with a flat white or pour-over. It's the kind of place where locals pop in for their morning ritual and visitors linger over a second cup. Whether you're grabbing takeaway beans to bring home or settling in with a laptop, the attention to detail in every cup makes it worth the visit.

Conveniently located within walking distance of Plett's shops and just a short drive from the beaches, it's an easy stop before heading to Robberg or after browsing the town. The vibe is unpretentious and genuine—just good coffee done right.
